in_marathi.name: Dileshwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of mountains
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dileshwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dilesh (God of mountains) + war (protector). The name Dileshwar is a compound of two Sanskrit words - Dile (God of mountains) and Ishwar (Lord, God). It is a name of Lord Shiva, who is considered the ruler of the mountains and the protector of the universe.
